shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin trades around $77K, experiencing slight dips amid persistent ETF outflows.
The Crypto Fear and Greed Index stands at 28 (indicating Fear), yet top traders are increasing Bitcoin long positions.
Odds for a Fed interest rate hike by September have risen to 37% amid inflation concerns from high oil prices.
Growing optimism for a US-Iran peace deal is viewed as a potential positive for risk assets, including crypto.
US lawmakers are pushing for a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Act to establish a $25 billion federal stash.
